first.rationale: I currently intend to simplify onboarding because completion and activation are both declining, and the inherited evidence indicates that shorter onboarding improves time-to-value and early adoption. I would verify the onboarding result and the pricing result before committing, since targeted pricing could address the competitor threat but may produce less sustainable qualified revenue. Run a guarded test with downstream activation and qualified-revenue checks to ensure fewer onboarding steps do not reduce customer quality or meaningful product adoption.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding, prioritizing the confirmed durable gains in completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention while directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines. Do not use promotional pricing: although it lifts short-term qualified revenue, the verified 12% retention decline indicates poor sustainable value. Monitor activation, qualified revenue, and retention by cohort to ensure the onboarding change improves durable growth rather than merely completion.
